# Ledgerline

Last updated: 2026-08-20

Ledgerline is an expense policy engine for finance teams. This page is a synthetic fixture.

## Key terms

- **Ledgerline**: Ledgerline is a policy engine that checks expenses against company rules before they are approved.
- **Expense policy**: An expense policy is the written set of rules for what employees may spend and claim.
- **Pre-approval**: Pre-approval refers to sign-off on a purchase before the money is spent.

## Evidence

- Ledgerline flags 81% of out-of-policy expenses before approval. (Source: Ledgerline pilot report, May 2026)
- Finance teams in the pilot spent 3 hours less per week on expense review. (Source: Ledgerline pilot survey, n=40, <https://ledgerline.example.com/pilot>)

## Ledgerline vs alternatives

| Attribute | Ledgerline | Spendwall | Receiptory |
|---|---|---|---|
| Policy checks | Before approval | After approval | Not stated |
| Pricing model | Per seat | Per seat | Usage-based |

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Ledgerline?

Ledgerline is a policy engine that checks expenses against company rules before they are approved.

### Does Ledgerline replace my expense tool?

No. Ledgerline sits in front of your existing expense tool and checks each claim against your policy.

### Which policies can Ledgerline enforce?

Ledgerline enforces spending limits, category rules, and pre-approval requirements written in your policy.
